title: Kinetic Typography lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 7 comps the round-3 Kinetic Typography templates were built and verified in: karaoke line, manifesto scroll, echo stack, opening credits, strike and replace, zoom through a letter and poster lockup.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 kinetic-type template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a lyric video, title sequence, manifesto or event promo, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.
parameters: poster lines (sizes come from measured ink widths)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (kko_, kms_, kes_, kcr_, ksr_, kzt_, kjl_).

Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/kinetic_type_lab3.py, two passes (a KT3 Measure comp of throwaway texts read with carvercat_authoring geometry, then the lab comps); every move is baked as keys, no presets to apply; open the file and edit.save. Needs Pillow for cc.textw.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings (notes only: held key values and the expo starts of the manifesto push).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
